title: Investigating the enhancement of the rate of CO2 capture of CaO in the presence of steam through 18O isotope labeling: pitfalls and findings
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,40188-40198
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05023E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Felix Donat, Christoph R. Müller
Steam enhances the rate of carbonation of CaO-based sorbents at high temperatures. 18O isotope labeling is used to understand whether steam participates actively in the formation of CaCO3.
